findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_portfolios · Private data: get_dividends, get_holdings, get_income_attribution, get_income_outlook, get_movements, get_options, get_performance, get_portfolio, get_radar, get_realized, get_tax_report, get_valuation, list_portfolios, list_stocks, screen_wheel · Public sink: get_dividends, get_holdings, get_income_outlook, get_valuation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_portfolios · Private data: get_dividends, get_holdings, get_income_attribution, get_income_outlook, get_movements, get_options, get_performance, get_portfolio, get_radar, get_realized, get_tax_report, get_valuation, list_portfolios, list_stocks, screen_wheel · Public sink: get_dividends, get_holdings, get_income_outlook, get_valuation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
